name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
summary: A window that asks a person to confirm a destructive or important action.
description: Interrupts to confirm a consequential action (delete, discard, revoke): no close button, and a click outside does not close it. Focus starts on the safe action and the question is announced at once (role="alertdialog"). It is the Dialog with two fixed actions, Cancel and the action named by its verb ("Delete project"); Escape cancels. The window, its motion, its stacking and its phone layout are the Dialog's. Controlled or uncontrolled.

anatomy.description: Layout-neutral hook (display: contents) around the Dialog, whose own parts (dialog-trigger, dialog-content, dialog-title, dialog-description, dialog-body, dialog-footer) render the window.
The first footer Button (ghost, sm), marked data-alert-dialog="cancel". Takes focus when the window opens. Closes without acting.
The second footer Button (sm; danger by default, primary when tone is neutral), marked data-alert-dialog="action". Calls onAction, then closes.

open.description: Controlled: open with onOpenChange. Uncontrolled: defaultOpen.

title.description: Required: the question, which names the window ("Delete billing-api?").

description.description: What happens, and whether it can be undone. Describes the window.

actionLabel.description: Label of the action: say what it does ("Delete project"), never "OK".

tone.description: danger: the action is a danger Button (a destructive confirm). neutral: a primary Button (an interruption that destroys nothing, such as leaving with unsent changes).

triggerLabel.description: Renders the Dialog's default Button trigger with this label. Otherwise pass your own trigger, or control `open`.

slots.trigger: Your own trigger element (React: the trigger prop; Vue: trigger slot; Svelte: trigger snippet receiving the props to spread)

events.action: () the action was pressed (the window then closes)
events.cancel: () Cancel, Escape, or a controlled close

keyboard: Enter / Space on the trigger open it; focus moves to Cancel
Tab and Shift+Tab cycle between Cancel and the action (and any control in the body); focus cannot leave the window
Escape cancels and returns focus to the trigger
A click on the dimmed page does nothing and never moves focus out of the window
notes: role="alertdialog", aria-modal, labelled by the title and described by the description: screen readers read both when it opens.
Focus starts on Cancel so that Enter pressed by habit does not destroy anything.
Opening and closing from the keyboard are instant (the Dialog's kbd-instant).

motion: the Dialog's: the window fades and scales from motion.popup-scale around its centre over duration.slow with easing.out-strong, the backdrop fades with it; it closes at duration.fast; instant from the keyboard
